svg.title: BT node types
svg.desc: A behavior tree drawn the py_trees way, root on the left. The root handle_cell is an orange box (a sequence, tag 1). Its three children are wait_for_reading, a gold parallelogram (a parallel, tag 3) with the leaves tester_ok and wait_for_voltage; retry_pick, a white ellipse (a decorator, tag 4) above the leaf pick_from_tester; and place_or_recycle, a cyan octagon (a selector, tag 2). The selector has two children: the sequence place_if_good, with the leaves voltage_in_range and place_in_slot, and the leaf recycle_cell. Leaves are gray ellipses (tag 5).
